title: Kakino stone circle with magnetic anomalies from lightning

tellings.quote: this exact same thing at a site called Kakino where it's a tough hillside.

plain: A stone circle on a hillside at Kakino in Japan is said to show odd magnetic readings caused by lightning, much like another site discussed on the show. A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who says he has seen such sites, mentions it to Michels in passing as "this exact same thing," without going into detail.
